2281-3175-6495.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sun Titan
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2281-3175-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1414-2866-4986-6495.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1414-2866-4986-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

6495-7084-7892.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-7084-7892.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1429-2829-3545.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

757-5087-5524-6995.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-5087-5524-6995.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Lulu to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Destiny Spinner, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

1512-4222-6723.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by tapping it, adding {U}.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Repeat.

2021-2060-3129-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2086-5686-6996.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

575-2292-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 6.

1456-4050-5078-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-4694-6774.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

3234-3293-5147-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5147-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5147-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

413-560-4550-5572.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
413-560-4550-5572.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Zombie and Soldier enter, Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3 with the other Blasting Station trigger, sacrificing the Soldier instead.
Repeat from step 1.

2665-3372-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Progenitor Mimic
2665-3372-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Progenitor Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Progenitor Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Progenitor Mimic's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Progenitor Mimic's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Progenitor Mimic's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

465-3742-4251-4875-6633.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3742-4251-4875-6633.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-2534-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

81-1491-4289-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
81-1491-4289-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
81-1491-4289-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2061-2493-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
2061-2493-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact with MV<=2 that has a generic mana cost

1306-1393-2292-4986--31.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Aether Channeler, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=2 by paying at most {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Aether Channeler, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1284-1857-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1284-1857-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1636-4312-5015.notablePrerequisites:
Thallid Shell-Dweller has at least three spore counters on it.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1636-4312-5015.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Thallid Shell-Dweller.
Activate Thallid Shell-Dweller by removing three spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana and you may target any creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
This combo also nets infinite spore counters on Thallid Shell-Dweller if it has four or more spore counters to start the combo.

594-2034-2835.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
594-2034-2835.description:
Activate Scuttletide by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Crab, adding {C}{C}.
The Crab dies, triggering Fecundity, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1446-2466-4050-4680-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1446-2466-4050-4680-4929.description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping The Hollow Sentinel, untapping it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1645-3581.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control, triggering Birgi and Kykar.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4498-5017-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter.
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You have the highest life total.
4498-5017-5115.description:
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Urban Daggertooth and a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

404-1521-2105-4460.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1521-2105-4460.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

1799-2034-2579.description:
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Grenzo, adding {C}{C}.
When Grenzo dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Grenzo from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Grenzo ability from step 1, causing you to put Grenzo from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting Grenzo onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
